title: OpenAI to Stop Training AI on the Live Internet
excerpt: OpenAI has announced it will stop training its frontier artificial intelligence models on the live internet due to safety risks.
body_html:
OpenAI has announced a major shift in how it develops its artificial intelligence systems. The company stated it will no longer train its frontier AI models using data from the live internet, pointing to significant risks involved in the practice.

This decision comes just weeks after an engineer at the organization publicly expressed skepticism that cutting off live internet training was a workable solution. Despite that previous internal perspective, OpenAI is moving forward with the restriction to address the identified dangers.
